theorems.name: Submission.frt_measure_null_of_hausdorff_null_ball_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (δ : ℝ), c ≠ ∞ → 0 < δ → μHE[n] A = 0 → (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ δ → μ (closedBall x ρ) ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) → μ A = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
